caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet comprised of two main sections. The upper section features two tall glass-paneled doors divided into rectangular panes with wooden muntins, allowing the contents inside to be visible. The lower section consists of a chest of drawers with six equal-sized drawers arranged in two columns and three rows, each drawer fitted with a simple round dark knob. The cabinet is colored in a warm, light-brown wood tone, and stands on slightly curved bracket feet. The background is plain and unadorned, with a neutral, off-white or beige color. The cabinet's structure is rectilinear with a flat top, and the overall composition centers the cabinet on the page.
title: Shaker Cabinet
